facts.fact: Decree 2023-1751 of 2 November 2023 creates the SIGE inside the ministry of preschool, primary, secondary education and literacy as a platform that registers each learner under a unique number and digitises grades, report cards and school record books, with data entry assigned to the schools (or their inspectorates); it is administered by the ministry's Direction des systèmes d'information et de la communication and maintained by the state agency ACSI.
facts.system: Système d'information de gestion de l'éducation (SIGE)

facts.fact: Decree 2023-1751 of 2 November 2023 provides that setting up and running the SIGE in public schools is financed by the State budget, gifts and legacies, and technical and financial partners, in private schools by a contribution from those schools, and that statistics and yearbooks are financed by the State budget; it names no amount or budget line.
facts.system: Système d'information de gestion de l'éducation (SIGE)

systems.system: Système d'information de gestion de l'éducation (SIGE)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'enseignement préscolaire, primaire, secondaire et de l'alphabétisation: administered by its Direction des systèmes d'information et de la communication, statistics by its Direction des études et de la planification, maintenance by the Agence congolaise des systèmes d'information (ACSI)
systems.tiers: as decreed: data entry by schools, or by their inspectorates; use by the cabinet, general inspectorate, directorates-general, departmental directorates and inspectorates; departmental administration by each departmental directorate's IT service

note: The decree is the founding text and states what the SIGE is to do, not that it is in use: it gives no school count, no rollout and no date of operation, so no fact is recorded for levels, how the record is kept or schools. Its seven modules include state examinations, school transfers, personnel and statistics, and its outputs include the statistical yearbooks and the carte scolaire as well as per-learner files.
